clips.title: The story
paras: Gryan Stoutmantle sends a hard answer from Sentinel Hill to Lakeshire. His dispatch tells Magistrate Solomon that the People's Militia cannot spare a single soldier for Redridge Mountains.

Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire asks Sentinel Hill for reinforcements as Blackrock orcs and gnolls press his town. Gryan Stoutmantle replies in writing with sorrow for Lakeshire's losses, but Westfall faces a war of its own. The People's Militia formed from desperation after the Crown withdrew its garrison. Farmers and volunteers now fight the Defias Brotherhood alone. Stoutmantle's forces are already bleeding and stretched thin, with no men to spare for another abandoned frontier.
